description: The plot illustrates how “Reliability Score” varies with “Cost” for three approaches (3-Model Ensemble, 2-Model Ensemble, and GPT-4). The x-axis is labeled “Cost,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 10 with tick labels shown at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10. The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Score,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 30 to 90 with labeled ticks at 30, 50, and 90 (a gridline is also shown at 70). Three solid lines with circular markers are plotted: the blue 3-Model Ensemble line decreases slightly across cost, from about 83 at cost 0 to about 79 at cost 5 and about 75 at cost 10; the red 2-Model Ensemble line also declines, from about 85 at cost 0 to about 79 at cost 5 and about 73 at cost 10; the yellow GPT-4 line drops more steeply, from about 89 at cost 0 to about 64 at cost 5 and about 40 at cost 10.
